content.title: McDonald's® The Huntrix Meal Review! | KPop Demon Hunter Adult Happy Meal | theendorsement
content.text: Today I review the NEW Huntrix Meal from McDonald's® ! ($10.49) The McDonald's® HUNTR/X Meal (often referred to as the Huntrix meal) is a limited-edition collaboration with the Netflix film KPop Demon Hunters, launched nationwide on Tuesday, March 31, 2026. This "adult" meal is inspired by the film's fictional girl group, HUNTR/X, and features several South Korean-inspired menu items. The meal is built around a standard 10-piece nugget combo but includes unique limited-time additions: 10-Piece Chicken McNuggets®: The core of the meal. Ramyeon McShaker™ Fries: Medium fries served with a seasoning packet featuring soy, garlic, sesame, and spices. You sprinkle the seasoning into a provided bag and shake it to coat the fries. Hunter Sauce: A sweet chili-flavored sauce with notes of garlic and pepper. Demon Sauce: A bold, spicy purple mustard sauce designed to mimic demon patterns from the film. Medium Soft Drink: Included as part of the combo. This sounds very interesting! But do I ENDORSE it? Please watch and find out.
